Many praised the researcher, Domas, for his work in exposing advanced malware and implants, and using techniques such as cpu fuzzer and msr fuzzing to discover the backdoor. Several potential solutions were proposed to mitigate the risk, including using a large FPGA with an open-source CPU, emulating a CPU with encrypted data and commands, and running code in a Virtual Machine. The discussion also touched on the technical aspects of the backdoor, including its location in a separate chip. The overall impression was that the project raises important questions about hardware security and the need for greater transparency in the development of complex hardware.
